title: PAR-40 / 7G.2 Background/SUN typed-to-raw pairing preflight
mode: local generated DXF implementation and focused validation
scope: Require DXF typed Background/SUN callbacks to pair with raw OBJECTS records by handle, owner, record kind, and captured source version
Keep DWG typed-only callback behavior separate from DXF raw carrier pairing
Reject malformed or incomplete pairs before writer publication
Keep rooted Background serialization, SUN owner qualification, external evidence, and support claims separate

behavior: Added a preflight pairing validator for typed/raw Background and SUN callbacks.
DXF pairing checks exact identity, owner, accepted record-name-to-kind mapping, and source revision; duplicate or unpaired carriers reject before writing.
DWG typed-only records do not require fabricated raw DXF carriers and remain subject to the pre-existing export refusal.
Correctly paired but unrooted Background/SUN records remain fail-closed at the existing ACAD_BACKGROUND/owner-graph guard.
generatedControls: Generated AC1027 ASCII/Binary records prove a valid typed/raw pair reaches the later unrooted-graph refusal.
Removing the raw Background companion proves incomplete coverage is rejected by the new pairing preflight.
The test preserves destination refusal and same-adapter retry controls.

focusedResults: Background/SUN typed and raw callback retention: PASS
VPORT shade-plot retention and fail-closed output: PASS; malformed negative controls print expected diagnostics

assessment.closedScope: DXF typed/raw Background and SUN callback pairing is checked as a pre-publication invariant; invalid/incomplete pairs have a distinct early failure boundary.
assessment.remaining: ACAD_BACKGROUND root/dictionary ownership, Background raw replay and reference closure, non-sharing rules, SUN exact owner closure, and positive writer/readback remain open.
